options.text: Mirror X is a plane mirror.
Mirror Y is a concave mirror.
Mirror Z is a concave mirror because the image is erect.
Mirror Y is a convex mirror because a larger image always means a wider view.

stem:
Sanya stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors. The diagram summarises the image of her face in each mirror.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Same-size erect image marks a plane mirror; a larger erect close-up marks concave. Smaller erect is convex, not concave; larger image does not mean convex.
teacher.figure_note: Three panels: X same-size erect, Y larger erect, Z smaller erect.
